title: waitForLoadState('networkidle') times out on pages with analytics, polling or websockets
symptoms: goto with waitUntil: 'networkidle' passes locally and times out in CI
Adding a chat widget or analytics script makes unrelated tests fail
cause: networkidle waits for 500 ms with zero open connections, which never happens on pages that poll or hold sockets. Playwright marks the option as discouraged for testing.
fix: Remove networkidle and wait for the thing the test needs with a web-first assertion.
affected: All Playwright versions, page.goto, page.waitForLoadState, page.waitForNavigation
